description: An abstract class extending ListFragment that manages app shortcuts and package events, including registration of broadcast receivers, callback handling for package changes, and permission checks within an Android launcher demo project.

classes.name: MyBaseListFragment
classes.description: An abstract fragment class that manages shortcut and package change events, handles permissions, and updates UI accordingly in an Android launcher demo.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UserManager and LauncherApps, registers launcher callback.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Logs resume, shows permission warning if needed, refreshes list, registers broadcast receiver.

methods.name: showPermissionWarningToastWhenNeeded
methods.description: Displays a toast warning if the app lacks shortcut host permission.

methods.name: getAppLabel
methods.description: Retrieves application label for a given package name, with caching.

methods.name: refreshList
methods.description: Abstract method to refresh the displayed list, to be implemented by subclasses.
